name: Search Tasks in Asana
description: Searches for tasks in an Asana workspace using filters like assignee, project, completion status, due dates, and text. Returns enriched results with assignee names, sections, and tags.

text.description: Text to search for in task names and descriptions

assignee.description: Assignee GID or 'me' to filter by assignment

completed.description: Filter by completion status. Omit to return both.

dueOnBefore.description: Return tasks due on or before this date (YYYY-MM-DD)

dueOnAfter.description: Return tasks due on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD)

isBlocked.description: Filter for tasks that are blocked by dependencies
